name: Voxel Attribute Decoupling
definition: A technique to decouple voxel attributes from geometry by storing attributes in a dense array and storing offsets (child index minus parent index) with each child pointer in a DAG, allowing index reconstruction during traversal.
summary: Voxel Attribute Decoupling separates geometry from attributes in Sparse Voxel Octrees, enabling independent compression and significant memory reduction by storing attributes in a dense array and encoding offsets in child pointers.
